text:
emma_finance: Heads up: OrionLabs has a dispute on invoice 70988. They say platform proration and a support downgrade charge both appeared; procurement wants correction.

thomas_am: Which invoice lines?

emma_finance: Quick snippet: 
- Private license (annual): $180,000
- Platform fee (annual): $35,000
- Platform proration (resize): $8,750
- Support downgrade adjustment (credit -> charge): $2,200
Balance: $225,950

nina_revops: Ops logs show they requested a pool shrink 10 days before renewal. The system should have delayed proration if within the 30-day renewal window, but I see the resize completed and generated a prorate invoice.

ops-bot: Event: pool-shrink request 2025-12-02T09:12Z. old_pool=D-XL -> new_pool=D-L. resize-id=orion-resize-20251202.

support_agent: Customer says they never requested a support level change. They had previously downgraded support in portal but later canceled; ticket #3421 shows an open cancellation request that wasn't processed.

lex_billing: NetSuite shows two adjustments: a prorate credit and a separate prorate charge; looks like offsetting entries failed to net. Also the support downgrade was auto-rebilled due to portal state mismatch. No manual approval recorded.

emma_finance: Proposal: (1) Issue corrective credit for erroneous support charge $2,200, (2) Put platform proration $8,750 on hold pending RevOps reconciliation, (3) Require RevOps to add a control: hold capacity adjustments within 15 days of renewal for manual review. Approve conditional on artifacts.

thomas_am: I'll notify Orion procurement that we're investigating and will correct billing if we find system error. Will request any PO amendments if needed.

nina_revops: I'll export the resize timeline, ops-bot events, and portal audit trail to Zendesk FIN-2790. If the resize occurred due to a confirmed customer request outside an approved waiver, we'll reconcile; otherwise we'll reverse the proration.

legal_bot: Check: support charges require customer consent per SOW. If portal shows a pending cancellation, we should reverse charge and record remediation. Document decision in ticket for audit.

lex_billing: Once FIN-2790 contains RevOps exports and support thread, billing will post credit memo $2,200 (GL 4202) for the support charge immediately. Platform proration will be held in AR pending RevOps confirmation.

emma_finance: Approve issuing support credit now. Hold on proration until RevOps provides artifacts. Tagging @nina_revops @lex_billing @thomas_am. :white_check_mark:

(End of thread)
